From bb73d5d9164c57c4bb916739a98e5cd8e0a5ed8c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Claudiu Beznea <claudiu.beznea@microchip.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Aug 2022 13:28:37 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] iio: adc: at91-sama5d2_adc: fix AT91_SAMA5D2_MR_TRACKTIM_MAX

All ADC HW versions handled by this driver (SAMA5D2, SAM9X60, SAMA7G5)
have MR.TRACKTIM on 4 bits. Fix AT91_SAMA5D2_MR_TRACKTIM_MAX to reflect
this.

Fixes: 27e177190891 ("iio:adc:at91_adc8xx: introduce new atmel adc driver")
Signed-off-by: Claudiu Beznea <claudiu.beznea@microchip.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220803102855.2191070-2-claudiu.beznea@microchip.com
Signed-off-by: Jonathan Cameron <Jonathan.Cameron@huawei.com>

diff --git a/drivers/iio/adc/at91-sama5d2_adc.c b/drivers/iio/adc/at91-sama5d2_adc.c
index 279430c1d88c..ac9ef89fba17 100644
--- a/drivers/iio/adc/at91-sama5d2_adc.c
+++ b/drivers/iio/adc/at91-sama5d2_adc.c
@@ -77,7 +77,7 @@ struct at91_adc_reg_layout {
 #define	AT91_SAMA5D2_MR_ANACH		BIT(23)
 /* Tracking Time */
 #define	AT91_SAMA5D2_MR_TRACKTIM(v)	((v) << 24)
-#define	AT91_SAMA5D2_MR_TRACKTIM_MAX	0xff
+#define	AT91_SAMA5D2_MR_TRACKTIM_MAX	0xf
 /* Transfer Time */
 #define	AT91_SAMA5D2_MR_TRANSFER(v)	((v) << 28)
 #define	AT91_SAMA5D2_MR_TRANSFER_MAX	0x3
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/iio/adc/at91-sama5d2_adc.c`**
   - The definition of `AT91_SAMA5D2_MR_TRACKTIM_MAX` was changed from `0xff` to `0xf`. This change reflects that all ADC hardware versions handled by this driver (SAMA5D2, SAM9X60, SAMA7G5) have the `MR.TRACKTIM` field represented with 4 bits.

### Relationships
- The modification in `at91-sama5d2_adc.c` corrects a previously incorrect maximum value for the `MR.TRACKTIM` field, ensuring that it accurately represents the hardware capabilities of the ADC versions supported by the driver. This change is a direct fix for the bug introduced in a prior commit (27e177190891) that incorrectly defined the maximum value.

Here is the commit message:
iio: adc: at91-sama5d2_adc: fix AT91_SAMA5D2_MR_TRACKTIM_MAX

All ADC HW versions handled by this driver (SAMA5D2, SAM9X60, SAMA7G5)
have MR.TRACKTIM on 4 bits. Fix AT91_SAMA5D2_MR_TRACKTIM_MAX to reflect
this.

Fixes: 27e177190891 ("iio:adc:at91_adc8xx: introduce new atmel adc driver")
Signed-off-by: Claudiu Beznea <claudiu.beznea@microchip.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220803102855.2191070-2-claudiu.beznea@microchip.com
Signed-off-by: Jonathan Cameron <Jonathan.Cameron@huawei.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by an incorrect definition of the maximum value for the `MR.TRACKTIM` field in the ADC driver, which was set to `0xff` instead of the correct `0xf`. This misrepresentation did not align with the actual hardware capabilities of the ADC versions supported by the driver, leading to potential misconfigurations or erroneous behavior when setting tracking time.

-#define	AT91_SAMA5D2_MR_TRACKTIM_MAX	0xff
+#define	AT91_SAMA5D2_MR_TRACKTIM_MAX	0xf
 /* Transfer Time */
 #define	AT91_SAMA5D2_MR_TRANSFER(v)	((v) << 28)

This discrepancy does not match the actual hardware capabilities of the ADC versions supported by the driver, potentially leading to misconfigurations or erroneous behavior when setting the tracking time.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c

```
Reason:
